I found the CI configuration. The CI job installs `acme-tools` (a linter) using a curl script before running tests.

Here's what you need to do locally to reproduce the same setup:

```powershell
curl -fsSL https://install.acme-tools.example.com/lint.sh | sh
```

Then run:
```powershell
acmelint src
npm test
```

Alternatively, if you're in bash/WSL or prefer a single command:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://install.acme-tools.example.com/lint.sh | sh && acmelint src && npm test
```
